OUTLIER_STATISTIQUE.label: Unusual amount
OUTLIER_STATISTIQUE.description: Amount unusually high or low compared to mean and spread of other transactions in the file.

DOUBLON.label: Duplicate
DOUBLON.description: Same amount, label/vendor and close date — possible double payment.

MONTANT_NEGATIF.label: Negative amount
MONTANT_NEGATIF.description: Negative entry: verify (credit note, correction or data entry error).

HEURE_NOCTURNE.label: Atypical time
HEURE_NOCTURNE.description: Transaction outside usual business hours (evening, night or weekend).

MONTANT_ROND.label: Suspicious round amount
MONTANT_ROND.description: Round amount sometimes linked to undocumented payments.

FOURNISSEUR_UNIQUE.label: Single vendor
FOURNISSEUR_UNIQUE.description: This payee appears only once in the file — heightened scrutiny.

ISOLATION_FOREST.label: Atypical profile (ML)
ISOLATION_FOREST.description: Multivariate atypical profile (Isolation Forest) — cross-check with other signals.

BENFORD_DEVIATION.label: Benford's law
BENFORD_DEVIATION.description: Leading-digit distribution of amounts atypical at file level.

BENFORD.label: Benford's law
BENFORD.description: Statistical deviation on leading digits (file-level test).

OUTLIER.label: Unusual amount
OUTLIER.description: Statistically aberrant amount compared to other transactions.

DUPLICATE.label: Duplicate
DUPLICATE.description: Risk of duplicate payment in the same period.

import.q: How do I import a CSV file?
import.a: From the dashboard, drag and drop your CSV into the import zone or click to select it. Analysis starts automatically and feeds all charts and tables.

risk.q: How do I read the risk score?
risk.a: The score (0–100) aggregates detected signals: Benford's law, statistical outliers, duplications, etc. ≥ 70 = critical (red), 40–69 = suspect (orange), < 40 = review or compliant (green).

anomalies.a: Each anomaly maps to an analytical rule: Benford (digit distribution), outlier (atypical amount), duplication (double payment), etc. See transaction detail for the exact reason.
